Privacy Policy

Last Updated: November 17, 2026

Introduction

Welcome to EvenHalf ("we," "our," or "us"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our task-sharing application.

1. Information We Collect

1.1 Information You Provide

Account Information:

  • Email address
  • Display name
  • Password (encrypted)
  • Profile picture (optional)

Task Data:

  • Task titles and descriptions
  • Due dates and priorities
  • Task status and assignments
  • Recurrence settings

Usage Data:

  • Login timestamps
  • Feature usage patterns
  • App interactions
  • Device information

1.2 Automatically Collected Information

Technical Data:

  • IP address
  • Device type and model
  • Operating system
  • Browser type and version
  • App version

Usage Events:

  • When you sign up, pair with a partner, create or complete a task, send a nudge, or start or end a Premium subscription, we record the event type, your account ID and the time. We use this only to understand how EvenHalf is used. We do not record task titles, descriptions or nudge messages for this purpose, we do not use third-party tracking or advertising SDKs, and these records are deleted when you delete your account.

1.3 Third-Party Data

Google OAuth:

  • Google account ID
  • Email address
  • Profile name
  • Profile picture (if authorized)

Push Notifications:

  • Device tokens (for notifications)
  • Notification preferences

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

2.1 Provide Services

  • Create and manage your account
  • Enable task sharing with your partner
  • Synchronize data in real-time
  • Send notifications and reminders
  • Provide customer support

2.2 Improve Services

  • Analyze usage patterns
  • Fix bugs and errors
  • Develop new features
  • Optimize performance
  • Conduct research

2.3 Communicate

  • Send service updates
  • Notify about account changes
  • Respond to inquiries
  • Share important announcements

2.4 Security

  • Detect and prevent fraud
  • Protect against abuse
  • Enforce our terms of service
  • Maintain system security

3. Data Sharing and Disclosure

3.1 With Your Partner

  • Tasks marked as "shared" are visible to your paired partner
  • Your display name and profile picture are visible to your partner
  • Pairing status and activity are shared

3.2 Tasks You Send by Link

  • When you send a task by link, anyone who has the link can see that task's title, notes, due date, priority and status, and your display name (unless it is your email address, which is never shown)
  • They can say they'll do it, say they can't, or mark it done, without an account. You see their response in the app
  • If you type their name, we store it with the link so we can show it to you
  • Links stop working after 30 days, or as soon as you turn them off
  • We don't send the message ourselves; you send it from your own phone or email, so we never receive the recipient's phone number or email address

3.3 With Service Providers

We share data with trusted third-party service providers:

Supabase (Database Hosting):

  • Stores your account and task data
  • Provides real-time synchronization
  • Location: [Supabase Region]
  • Privacy Policy

Google (Authentication):

  • Processes OAuth sign-in
  • Verifies identity
  • Privacy Policy

Stripe (Payments, Premium only):

  • Processes Premium subscription payments; your card details go directly to Stripe and are never seen or stored by EvenHalf
  • We store your Stripe customer and subscription IDs and subscription status
  • Privacy Policy

Firebase (Notifications):

  • Delivers push notifications
  • Manages device tokens
  • Privacy Policy

3.4 Legal Requirements

We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to:

  • Court orders or subpoenas
  • Legal processes
  • Government requests
  • Protection of our rights
  • Emergency situations

3.5 Business Transfers

In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred to the new entity.

3.6 We Do NOT Sell Your Data

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

4. Data Security

4.1 Security Measures

We implement industry-standard security measures:

Encryption:

  • Data encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS)
  • Passwords hashed using bcrypt
  • Sensitive data encrypted at rest

Access Controls:

  • Row-level security policies
  • Role-based access control
  • Multi-factor authentication support

Monitoring:

  • Regular security audits
  • Intrusion detection systems
  • Error monitoring and alerts

4.2 Your Responsibility

You are responsible for:

  • Keeping your password secure
  • Not sharing your account
  • Logging out on shared devices
  • Reporting suspicious activity

4.3 Limitations

No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

5. Data Retention

5.1 Active Accounts

  • We retain your data as long as your account is active
  • Tasks and history are preserved for your convenience

5.2 Deleted Accounts

  • Account data is permanently deleted within 30 days
  • Backup copies deleted within 90 days
  • Some metadata may be retained for legal compliance

5.3 Inactive Accounts

  • Accounts inactive for 12+ months may be deleted after notice
  • You'll receive email warning before deletion

6. Your Rights and Choices

6.1 Access and Portability

  • View your data in the app settings
  • Request a copy of your data
  • Export your tasks (feature coming soon)

6.2 Correction

  • Update your profile information
  • Edit or delete tasks
  • Change notification preferences

6.3 Deletion

  • Delete individual tasks
  • Unpair from your partner
  • Delete your entire account

6.4 Opt-Out

  • Disable push notifications
  • Unsubscribe from emails
  • Limit data collection (where applicable)

6.5 GDPR Rights (EU Users)

If you're in the European Union, you have additional rights:

  • Right to be forgotten
  • Right to data portability
  • Right to restrict processing
  • Right to object to processing
  • Right to lodge a complaint with supervisory authority

6.6 CCPA Rights (California Users)

If you're a California resident, you have the right to:

  • Know what personal information is collected
  • Know if information is sold or disclosed
  • Say no to the sale of information
  • Access your information
  • Equal service and price

7. Cookies and Tracking

7.1 Essential Cookies

  • Session management
  • Authentication tokens
  • Security features
  • Cannot be disabled

7.2 Analytics Cookies

  • Usage statistics
  • Performance monitoring
  • Can be disabled in settings
  • Visitor analytics on evenhalf.namasteneedham.com (the app, the landing page and the website), provided by Vercel Web Analytics. It does not use cookies and does not track you across sites. It records aggregate page views with approximate country and device type, and never the contents of the share-link pages (/t/)

7.3 Third-Party Cookies

  • Google OAuth
  • Analytics services
  • Governed by their privacy policies

8. Children's Privacy

EvenHalf is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

If you believe a child has provided us with information:

  • Contact us immediately
  • We will delete the account
  • We will remove all associated data

9. International Data Transfers

Your data may be transferred to and stored in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place:

  • Standard contractual clauses
  • Privacy Shield frameworks
  • Adequate protection measures
